articles.title: A Multi-Stage Agentic Framework for Effective Counter-Narrative Generation and Refinement
articles.abstract: The rapid diffusion of hate speech and misinformation on social networks challenges democratic societies, since direct suppression efforts may deepen polarization, fuel public distrusts, and strengthen extremist narratives. LLM-driven counter-narratives (CNs) offer a promising way to reduce those risks, yet their effectiveness depends on rhetorical and stylistic choices that remain poorly understood. We present a multi-stage agent-based framework for generating, refining, and evaluating CNs, applied to pro-Russian hate and misinformation narratives on the war with Ukraine and adaptable to other domains. A pilot experiment with human evaluators identifies effective technique style pairings, such as repetition with emotional framing enhancing persuasiveness. Building on these insights, we introduce a multi-agent refinement process that iteratively improves CNs for persuasiveness, emotional engagement, and shareability. After human validation confirmed improvement, an automated safety analysis shows that our refined CNs match or improve on expert-written counterspeech. A simulated experiment then shows that they reduce the perceived strength of pro-Russian narratives and consistently outperform a vanilla LLM baseline, highlighting a pathway toward scalable, narrative-specific interventions against hate speech and misinformation. Code and data accompanying this work are publicly available at https://github.com/carmelkron/inlg2026-counter-narratives.
articles.titleCn: 一个用于有效反叙事生成和完善的分阶段代理框架
articles.abstractCn: 社交网络上仇恨言论和虚假信息的快速传播对民主社会构成挑战，因为直接的压制措施可能加剧两极分化、助长公众不信任，并强化极端主义叙事。由大型语言模型驱动的反叙事（CNs）为降低这些风险提供了有前景的途径，但其有效性取决于仍不甚明了的修辞和风格选择。我们提出了一种多阶段基于代理的框架，用于生成、完善和评估反叙事，应用于关于乌克兰战争的亲俄仇恨言论和虚假信息叙事，并可适用于其他领域。一项由人类评估员参与的试点实验确定了有效的技术风格搭配，例如重复结合情感框架可增强说服力。基于这些见解，我们引入了一种多代理完善过程，迭代提升反叙事的说服力、情感参与度和可分享性。在人类验证确认改进后，自动化的安全分析表明，我们完善后的反叙事与专家撰写的反言论相当或更优。随后的模拟实验显示，它们降低了亲俄叙事的感知强度，并始终优于普通的LLM基线，凸显了针对仇恨言论和虚假信息进行可扩展、叙事特定的干预措施的一条途径。这项工作的代码和数据已公开发布在 https://github.com/carmelkron/inlg2026-counter-narratives。

articles.title: Inherited Heads: Audio language models track speakers with their text backbone's attention, and an attention-mass ranking retrieves a different set
articles.abstract: Asked to describe what one of six speakers in a recording talks about, audio language models describe the right one on 6 to 16% of trials, below the 16.7% a guess would give. Adding a fixed bias to the attention logits of a hundred heads, under a tenth of the model's and with no training, redirects the description to whichever speaker we choose, on 90.7% to 99.0% of trials. Those heads are largely not specific to audio. Rank the text-only language model an audio model was built from, or a released model of the same family, on a written version of the task, take its top hundred heads, and carry them over unchanged: they redirect the audio model on 80.8% to 95.0% of trials, with nothing about audio entering the selection. The audio and text head sets share 66 to 74 of 100 where chance would give about 20, and the shared part alone reproduces almost all of the steering. What that does not show is that sharing is what makes the heads work: an equal-sized draw from the same discovered hundred does nearly as well, and none of our three models separates the two explanations. A second finding concerns how such heads are found. Ranking heads by how much attention they place on the segment asked about, as an established score does, or by how much of their attention moves with the question, as a per-head normalised variant does, gives top hundreds that share 69, 37 and 4 heads across our three models. In Ultravox, where they share 4, the established score's heads leave output the judge cannot place on any segment on 69.7% of trials, against 40.0% with no intervention and 1.0% for the normalised variant. That is one arm of six; on the other five the established score steers above a random draw.
articles.titleCn: 继承式头部：音频语言模型通过其文本主干中的注意力机制跟踪说话人，而注意力质量排名会检索出不同的说话人集合
articles.abstractCn: 要求描述录音中六位发言人之一谈论的内容，音频语言模型在6到16%的试验中描述正确的发言人，低于猜测的16.7%。通过向一百个头的注意力logits中添加固定偏差，仅使用模型不到十分之一且无需训练，就能在90.7%到99.0%的试验中将描述引导至我们选择的发言人。这些头在很大程度上并非专门针对音频。对从音频模型构建的文本语言模型或同一系列的发布模型在任务书面版本上的排名，取其前一百个头并保持不变：它们在80.8%到95.0%的试验中重新引导音频模型，且与音频无关的选择进入。音频和文本头集合共享66到74个中的100个，而运气会给出约20个，共享部分几乎完全重现了引导效果。这并未表明共享是使头起作用的原因：从同一发现的百个头中随机抽取相同大小的样本效果几乎一样好，而且我们的三个模型都无法区分这两种解释。第二个发现涉及如何找到这些头。根据它们对所问段落分配多少注意力（如成熟评分所做的那样）或根据它们的注意力有多少随问题移动（如每个头归一化的变体所做的那样），排名前一百的头在我们的三个模型中共享69、37和4个头。在Ultravox中，它们共享4个，成熟评分的头在69.7%的试验中产生输出，评委无法将其归因于任何段落，而无干预时为40.0%，归一化变体为1.0%。这是六臂中的一臂；在另外五臂上，成熟评分的引导优于随机抽取。

articles.title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Context parameterization enables large language models (LLMs) to internalize contexts into reusable model parameters, avoiding repeated processing across subsequent queries. However, existing methods typically assume static contexts and lack explicit mechanisms for distinguishing validity states under continual updates. To study this real-world scenario, we formalized the Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE) task and constructed MUSE-bench to evaluate update incorporation and unaffected-information preservation. The resulting challenge requires preserving the global state while adjusting the contribution of memory evidence. Motivated by this, we proposed PLUME, a training-free method that constructs a global update representation, activates memory evidence to form a local parameter view, and adaptively integrates their predictions during decoding. Comprehensive evaluation on MUSE-bench demonstrated PLUME's effectiveness in sequential evolution settings, yielding relative improvements of 29.9% in average ROUGE-L Recall and 54.9% in LLM-as-a-Judge. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/xiaobingshi-LLM/PLUME.
articles.titleCn: 面向大型语言模型的进化上下文参数化
articles.abstractCn: 上下文参数化使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够将上下文内化到可重用的模型参数中，从而避免在后续查询中重复处理。然而，现有方法通常假设静态上下文，并且缺乏在持续更新下区分有效状态的明确机制。为了研究这一现实场景，我们形式化了记忆更新与顺序演化（MUSE）任务，并构建了MUSE-bench来评估更新整合和未受影响信息保留。由此产生的挑战要求在调整记忆证据贡献的同时保持全局状态。受此启发，我们提出了PLUME，这是一种无需训练的方法，它构建全局更新表示，激活记忆证据以形成局部参数视图，并在解码过程中自适应地整合它们的预测。在MUSE-bench上的综合评估表明，PLUME在顺序演化环境中非常有效，平均ROUGE-L召回率相对提高了29.9%，LLM-as-a-Judge指标相对提高了54.9%。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/xiaobingshi-LLM/PLUME。

articles.title: When Tools Get in the Way: The Effect of Unnecessary Tool Availability on LLM Answering
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with external tools that extend what they can do beyond their own knowledge. Tools help on tasks that need external information, but their availability may also change how a model handles questions that do not need them. Prior work has mostly asked whether models select and use tools appropriately; whether an unnecessary tool changes the correctness of answers has received less attention. We ask whether making a related but unnecessary tool available affects a model's ability to answer from its own knowledge, and whether a preceding tool interaction changes this behaviour. We construct 500 query pairs across 10 knowledge domains. Each pair consists of a tool query, which needs the domain's tool, and a closed-domain query, which does not. Six LLMs are evaluated with the tool unavailable, available, and available after a prior tool call. Across 3,000 baseline trials the pooled answer rate is 98.2%. When an unnecessary tool is available it falls to 63.5%, with large differences between models. The decrease occurs even when the tool is rarely called, so it cannot be explained by unnecessary tool invocation alone. A one-sentence scope-aware system instruction recovers most of the lost answers.
articles.titleCn: 工具碍事时：不必要工具可用性对大型语言模型回答的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地与外部工具结合使用，以扩展其功能范围，超越自身知识。这些工具有助于需要外部信息的任务，但它们的可用性也可能改变模型处理不需要工具的问题的方式。以往的研究主要关注模型是否适当选择和使用工具；而不必要的工具是否会影响答案的正确性则受到较少关注。我们探究提供相关但非必要的工具是否会影响模型利用自身知识回答问题的能力，以及之前的工具交互是否会影响这种行为。我们在10个知识领域构建了500对查询。每对查询包括一个需要该领域工具的工具查询，以及一个不需要工具的封闭领域查询。我们评估了6个LLM在工具不可用、可用以及之前调用工具后可用的情况下的表现。在3000次基准试验中，合并的答案率为98.2%。当提供不必要的工具时，这一比率降至63.5%，且不同模型之间存在显著差异。即使工具很少被调用，这种下降仍然发生，因此不能仅用不必要的工具调用来解释。一个单句范围感知的系统指令能够恢复大部分丢失的答案。

articles.title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Setting Inference Depth from the Questions a Deployment Actually Asks
articles.abstract: A transformer language model is trained to respond to any prompt, but each deployment asks only a narrow range of questions: a support assistant sees delivery complaints, a coding tool sees Python. Every deployment nonetheless pays the same computation per token. This paper measures how much of that cost is avoidable when the range of prompts is known in advance. The mechanism examined is early exit: a small, trained component - called a readout - is attached to an intermediate layer and proposes a token, and a confidence test decides whether to emit it or to run the remaining layers. The models are frozen, and the only supervision used is the model's own output on ordinary traffic. Three findings are reported. First, achievable savings depend strongly on the kind of traffic: at half depth on a 1.5-billion-parameter model, 96 percent of tokens could be emitted early for arithmetic word problems and 8 percent for Chinese-language explanations, at matched token-level fidelity to the full model (a measure whose limits the third finding exposes). Second, of three ways a deployment might use knowledge of its traffic, only customizing the threshold for exiting early is worthwhile: calibrating it per deployment raised exit rates by up to 59 percentage points across three models, and by more than 10 points on most corpora tested. Third, token-level fidelity - the standard evaluation measure in the early-exit literature - fails in domains where tokens can be checked against ground truth: on arithmetic word problems, three models each answered sixty questions correctly when run in full, and between 10 and 28 correctly under early exit, in the configuration that scored highest on fidelity. The intended setting is small models on personal devices, where generation is limited by memory bandwidth rather than computation.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 tables in main text, 9 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at https://github.com/jerrykaplan/question-conditioned-early-exit
articles.titleCn: 一种尺寸并不适合所有：根据部署实际提出的问题设置推理深度
articles.abstractCn: 一种Transformer语言模型被训练以响应任何提示，但每次部署仅要求狭窄范围的问题：支持助手看到交付投诉，编码工具看到Python。尽管如此，每次部署都支付相同数量的计算成本每个标记。本文测量了当提示范围已知时，其中多少成本可以避免。考察的机制是提前退出：一个小型训练组件——称为读取输出——连接到中间层并提出一个标记，置信度测试决定是发出它还是运行剩余层。模型被冻结，仅使用的监督是模型在常规流量上的输出。报告了三个发现。首先，可实现的节省很大程度上取决于流量类型：在一个1.5十亿参数模型的一半深度上，96%的标记可以提前发出用于算术应用问题，8%用于中文解释，与完整模型的匹配标记级保真度（第三项发现揭示了该指标的局限性）。其次，在部署可能使用其流量知识的三种方式中，只有调整提前退出的阈值是值得的：针对每个部署进行校准，在三个模型中提高了高达59个百分点的退出率，并在大多数测试语料库上提高了10个以上。第三，标记级保真度——早期退出文献中的标准评估指标——在可以与真实情况对照的领域失效：在算术应用问题上，三个模型在完整运行时各正确回答了六十个问题，而在提前退出配置中，在保真度得分最高的配置下，正确回答的数量在10到28之间。预期环境是个人设备上的小型模型，其中生成受内存带宽限制而非计算限制。

articles.title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Although existing multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated promise on complex multimodal reasoning tasks, they remain fundamentally limited in reasoning depth and memory structure, suffering from inadequate retrieval and state blindness when answering knowledge-intensive questions. To address these limitations, we propose GraMRAG, a graph memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that integrates a dynamic multimodal memory graph to enable stable, multi-step multimodal reasoning. We introduce a vision-text bridged reasoning paradigm that unifies multi-scale entity cropping with a ReAct-style visual toolchain, enhancing the long-horizon cross-modal reasoning capability. We further construct a multimodal memory graph that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG), explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to mitigate state blindness and suppress redundant retrieval. Moreover, we propose Topology-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO) that leverages graph topology for critical path identification and targeted node pruning, enabling fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on challenging multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex long-horizon reasoning tasks.
articles.titleCn: 基于图记忆的强化学习多智能体多步推理协调方法：GraMRAG
articles.abstractCn: 尽管现有的多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统在复杂多模态推理任务上展现了潜力，但它们在推理深度和记忆结构上仍存在根本性局限，在回答知识密集型问题时表现出检索不足和状态盲点的问题。为解决这些局限，我们提出了GraMRAG，一个图记忆引导的多智能体RAG框架，该框架集成了动态多模态记忆图，以实现稳定的多步多模态推理。我们引入了一种视觉-文本桥接推理范式，将多尺度实体裁剪与ReAct风格的视觉工具链相结合，增强了长时程跨模态推理能力。此外，我们构建了一个多模态记忆图，将智能体推理形式化为动态有向无环图（DAG），明确建模行动-观察依赖关系，以缓解状态盲点并抑制冗余检索。此外，我们提出了拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO），该优化利用图拓扑进行关键路径识别和目标节点剪枝，从而在多步推理轨迹中实现细粒度的信用分配。在具有挑战性的多模态基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法始终优于现有基线，并在复杂的长时程推理任务上实现了最先进的性能。

articles.title: Measuring the Creativity of Frontier LLMs in Automated Research
articles.abstract: Frontier LLMs are increasingly capable of conducting automated research, yet their creativity in this setting has not been systematically evaluated. In this paper, we propose a set of metrics to evaluate creativity along the two dimensions of valueness and novelty. Valueness assesses whether each proposed idea is useful, while novelty is evaluated from three perspectives: whether the same idea has appeared before (Exact-Match P-Novelty), whether a previously unexplored variable or variable combination is explored (Variable-level P-Novelty), and whether the idea directly follows retrieved external knowledge or departs from it (H-Novelty). Our evaluation shows that the models achieve relatively similar scores on most creativity metrics, but differ substantially in Variable-level P-Novelty, which reflects the breadth of research-space exploration. Further correlation and idea-level performance analyses show that Variable-level P-Novelty is the creativity dimension most strongly associated with research performance.
articles.titleCn: 在自动化研究中测量前沿大型语言模型的创造力
articles.abstractCn: 前沿的大型语言模型在自动化研究方面日益强大，但它们在此环境下的创造力尚未得到系统评估。在本文中，我们提出了一套沿价值性和新颖性两个维度评估创造力的指标。价值性评估每个提出的想法是否实用，而新颖性则从三个方面进行评估：同一想法是否出现过（精确匹配P-新颖性）、是否探索了之前未涉足的变量或变量组合（变量级P-新颖性），以及想法是否直接遵循检索到的外部知识或偏离它（H-新颖性）。我们的评估表明，模型在大多数创造力指标上得分相对相似，但在变量级P-新颖性上差异显著，后者反映了研究空间探索的广度。进一步的关联分析和想法级性能分析表明，变量级P-新颖性是与研究性能关联最强的创造力维度。

articles.title: VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification
articles.abstract: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.
articles.comment: accepted by EMNLP 2026, 17 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
articles.titleCn: VeriDx：以疾病为中心验证赢得诊断权
articles.abstractCn: 即使出于错误的原因，仍然可以达到正确的诊断。在临床推理中，每个疾病假设都会产生义务：必须检查关键证据，排除替代方案，解决矛盾，考虑有用的测试，并证明结论的合理性。当前对医疗大型语言模型的评估主要集中在最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实上，因此忽略了这些假设引起的义务。我们介绍了 \textbf{VeriDx}，这是一个以疾病为中心的验证框架，它将自由形式的诊断推理与结构化的疾病档案联系起来。VeriDx 跟踪每个假设是否得到满足、悬而未决或违反了其临床义务，揭示了诸如遗漏关键测试、未解决的鉴别诊断、忽略矛盾、缺乏支持性主张和过早得出结论等失败情况。我们使用指南衍生的疾病档案和专家标注的纵向案例，对 VeriDx 进行了针对复杂呼吸系统诊断的实例化。我们的结果表明，许多诊断错误并非孤立失误，而是推理过程中早期产生的义务被违反。

articles.title: TF-IDF and BM25 Are Exact KL Divergences
articles.abstract: TF-IDF and BM25 are two of the most widely used methods for scoring query-document relevance, yet neither has a standard probabilistic derivation that justifies it as a statistical method within a unified framework. We address this gap by showing that both scoring methods admit an exact interpretation as Kullback-Leibler divergences between two probability models. We treat the BM25 variant that includes the plus 1 correction in the IDF term, which is the one used in practice, and also discuss the original BM25 formulation without that correction. The resulting framework provides a common theoretical basis for TF-IDF and BM25, clarifies what they measure, and allows them to be compared theoretically with other information retrieval methods rather than only experimentally.
articles.titleCn: TF-IDF和BM25是精确的KL散度
articles.abstractCn: TF-IDF和BM25是两种最广泛使用的评分查询-文档相关性的方法，但它们都没有一个标准的概率推导，无法作为统一框架内的统计方法进行解释。我们通过证明这两种评分方法都可以被精确地解释为两个概率模型之间的Kullback-Leibler散度来填补这一空白。我们处理了包含IDF项中加1校正的BM25变体，这是实际应用中使用的版本，同时也讨论了没有这种校正的原始BM25公式。由此产生的框架为TF-IDF和BM25提供了一个共同的理论基础，阐明了它们所测量的内容，并允许它们在理论上而不是仅仅通过实验与其他信息检索方法进行比较。

articles.title: Unlocking the Unsolvable: Teacher-Guided Curriculum for Data-Efficient RLVR
articles.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown remarkable success in improving the mathematical reasoning of large language models. Yet problems beyond the model's current capability, where rollouts uniformly fail and no learning signal is produced, are structurally wasted despite marking the most informative training frontier. We show that these otherwise-inert problems can be unlocked via teacher-guided curriculum learning: partial reasoning traces from a stronger model create a graded difficulty landscape, and a backward-chaining curriculum progressively withdraws guidance until the model solves problems unaided. Training on only 128 unsolvable problems matches or exceeds GRPO trained on a full 2,000-problem corpus (~16x data efficiency) on the nine-benchmark average for both base models, while substantially expanding the reasoning boundary measured by pass@k at large k. Furthermore, we identify a distribution-shift cost that is particularly acute in the unsolvable-only regime and propose Monotone Frontier Curriculum (MFC), a method that monotonically drives training toward unguided solving, consistently outperforming existing curriculum methods.

articles.titleCn: 解锁无解问题：教师引导型课程，用于数据高效的强化视觉推理
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升大型语言模型的数学推理能力方面已展现出显著成效。然而，对于超出模型当前能力范围的问题，尽管这些问题标志着最具信息量的训练前沿，但由于所有策略均失败且无学习信号产生，其结构上仍被浪费。我们证明，这些原本惰性化的问题可以通过教师引导的循序渐进学习被解锁：更强大模型的推理部分轨迹会创建一个分级难度景观，而反向链式课程会逐步撤回指导，直至模型无需辅助即可解决问题。仅对128个无法解决的问题进行训练，在九项基准测试的平均分上，与在全部2000个问题的语料库（~16倍数据效率）上训练的GRPO相比，两者表现相当或更优，同时大幅扩展了以大k值下的pass@k度量的推理边界。此外，我们识别出一种分布偏移成本，在仅包含无法解决的问题的情况下尤为突出，并提出了单调前沿课程（MFC）方法，该方法单调地推动训练朝向无引导解决，持续超越现有的循序渐进学习方法。

articles.title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context
articles.abstract: Arabic large-language-model (LLM) evaluation has matured around Modern Standard Arabic (MSA): aggregated leaderboards such as the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL), HELM Arabic, and BALSAM rank models across dozens of MSA tasks, and frontier systems increasingly saturate them. Dialectal Arabic, the language Iraqis actually speak, remains nearly invisible to this infrastructure. We introduce Mizan ("the balance"), Iraq's national benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi civic context: an MSA baseline track paired with an Iraqi track across six axes (dialect comprehension, dialect generation, bidirectional MSA-Iraqi translation, Iraq-specific knowledge, official-document field extraction, and safety), built from 340 originally authored, dually reviewed items with statistically audited answer positions and Wilson intervals on every published score. A pilot evaluation of 27 systems, spanning closed frontier models three days after release, open weights across size tiers, and an Arabic trio of commercial, open-specialized, and sovereign systems, yields four findings. The MSA track saturates while the Iraqi track discriminates, with a consistent 14-18-point per-model gap and statistically tied leaders. Official-document extraction confines every system to 32-56. Arabic-focused specialization behaves as MSA specialization: two dedicated Arabic models score below a size-matched generalist on the Iraqi track. And the safety-hardened tier of the newest model family deterministically refuses innocuous dialect-comprehension items as policy violations, an over-refusal mode invisible to MSA benchmarks. The platform enforces an integrity protocol of immutable snapshots, verification certificates, a human publication gate, and public retraction, all exercised during this study. Code and the public development set accompany the paper.

articles.titleCn: 米赞：评估伊拉克阿拉伯语和伊拉克公民背景下的大型语言模型的国家级基准
articles.abstractCn: 阿拉伯大型语言模型（LLM）评估已围绕现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）成熟：包括开放阿拉伯LLM排行榜（OALL）、HELM阿拉伯和BALSAM在内的聚合排行榜在数十项MSA任务中对模型进行排名，前沿系统正日益饱和这些任务。伊拉克人实际使用的方言阿拉伯语仍几乎无法被这一基础设施所识别。我们介绍了Mizan（意为“平衡”），这是伊拉克用于评估伊拉克阿拉伯语和伊拉克公民环境下的LLM的国家基准：一个MSA基线轨道与一个跨越六个轴（方言理解、方言生成、双向MSA-伊拉克语翻译、伊拉克特定知识、官方文件领域提取和安全）的伊拉克轨道相结合，这些轨道由340个最初撰写、双重审查的项目构成，具有经过统计审核的答案位置和每个已发布分数的威尔逊区间。一项涵盖27个系统的试点评估，包括发布后三天内的封闭前沿模型、不同规模级别的开放权重，以及阿拉伯语三组商业、开放专业和主权系统，产生了四个发现。MSA轨道饱和而伊拉克轨道具有区分性，模型间始终存在14-18分的差距，且统计上领导者相同。官方文件提取将所有系统限制在32-56分。专注于阿拉伯语的专业化行为与MSA专业化类似：两个专用阿拉伯语模型在伊拉克轨道上的得分低于规模匹配的通用模型。最新模型系列的最新安全强化层将无害方言理解项目确定为政策违规，这种过度拒绝模式对MSA基准不可见。该平台执行了不可变快照、验证证书、人工发布门禁和公开撤回的完整性协议，所有这些都在本研究中得到了实施。论文附有代码和公共开发集。

articles.title: Thought without systematicity? Evaluating reasoning models on rule induction tasks
articles.abstract: A central tenet of human cognition is systematicity, the principle that understanding one concept is inherently tied to understanding close variations of that concept. Do reasoning models robustly exhibit such systematicity? If so, we would expect consistent performance on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. Here, we extend established rule induction tasks from cognitive science to assess the systematicity of thought in current reasoning models. Each task family has compositional structure that we use to create structurally equivalent task variations through task isomorphisms such as recombination and substitution. We find that despite being able to correctly solve a task, models often fail on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. These findings suggest that many model behaviors lack systematicity, rendering it difficult to robustly establish the cognitive abilities of reasoning models beyond the particular contexts they were evaluated in.
articles.titleCn: 缺乏系统性思考？在规则归纳任务上评估推理模型
articles.abstractCn: 人类认知的一个核心原则是系统性，即理解一个概念本质上与理解该概念的各种相近变体紧密相连。推理模型是否确实表现出这种系统性？如果是，我们预计模型在结构等价的同一任务变体上会表现出一致的性能。在这里，我们将认知科学中已有的规则归纳任务扩展到当前推理模型，以评估思维的系统性。每个任务家族都具有组合结构，我们利用任务同构（如重组和替换）来创建结构等价的任务变体。我们发现，尽管模型能够正确解决一个任务，但它们往往在结构等价的同一任务变体上表现不佳。这些发现表明，许多模型行为缺乏系统性，这使得我们难以在模型被评估的特定环境之外，稳健地确立其推理能力。

articles.title: CRITICS - Critical Science Without Borders: Language Models to Promote Critical Thinking in Science Education
articles.abstract: The CRITICS project addresses science accessibility and literacy by converging advanced Machine Translation (MT) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) with educational technology. By leveraging MT systems specifically optimized for scientific content, educational institutions can provide accurate, culturally relevant translations of scientific materials in students' native languages, ensuring that complex scientific concepts are comprehensible while maintaining technical accuracy. Building on these translations, the project explores the design and evaluation of innovative science teaching-learning proposals grounded in curriculum-aligned teaching-learning. Thus, CRITICS will investigate key components of scientific argumentation and critical thinking practices together with textual feedback aligned with learning objectives and assessment criteria inspired by competence-based evaluation frameworks. CRITICS aims to break down language barriers to accessing cutting-edge research and educational materials currently available only in high-resourced languages, thereby facilitating the democratization of scientific knowledge and fostering critical thinking in science education.
articles.titleCn: 评论家 - 无国界的批判性科学：语言模型促进科学教育中的批判性思维
articles.abstractCn: CRITICS项目通过将基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的先进机器翻译（MT）与教育技术相结合，致力于提升科学知识的可及性和科学素养。通过利用专门针对科学内容优化的MT系统，教育机构能够提供准确且符合文化背景的学生母语科学材料翻译，确保复杂科学概念的可理解性，同时保持技术上的精确性。基于这些翻译，该项目探索了与课程内容相一致的教学学习方案的设计与评估。因此，CRITICS将研究科学论证的关键要素和批判性思维实践，并结合与学习目标和基于能力评价框架的评估标准相一致的文本反馈。CRITICS旨在打破语言障碍，以获取目前仅在资源丰富语言中可用的尖端研究和教育材料，从而促进科学知识的民主化，并培养科学教育中的批判性思维。

articles.title: Inter-Rater Reliability of LLM and Rule-Based Annotation for Inferential Narrative Features: Three Studies on a Turkish Corpus
articles.abstract: Datasets that ship automatically generated feature annotations invite a question rarely asked of them: would a human agree with those labels? This report answers that for the Objective Projection corpus, a Turkish narrative dataset whose scenes carry a per-scene applied_rules field from a rule-based detector over six craft features -- two prohibitions (emotion labelling, simile) and four positive techniques (materialized metaphor, micro-focus, temporal anchor, atmosphere contradiction). Three studies are reported. Study 1 ($n = 120$) scores the detector against blind labels from the scheme's own author. Study 2 ($n = 100$, a disjoint scene set) scores the detector plus Gemini 2.5 Flash and Grok against an independent non-expert rater whose labels were locked before any machine ran. Study 2b re-runs the identical protocol with Claude Fable 5 (High) and ChatGPT 5.5. The central result concerns one rule. On materialized metaphor -- closest to the methodology's theoretical core -- the five machine labellers returned positive rates of $0$, $1$, $40$, $72$ and $78$ out of $100$ scenes, against a human count of $9$. Cohen's $κ$ was at or indistinguishable from chance for five of six labellers, across both human references and both scene sets: $0.004$, $0.015$, $0.000$, $0.019$, $0.027$. Raw agreement ranged from $74.7\%$ to $84.5\%$, an artefact of class imbalance rather than a sign of competence. We deliberately do not resolve this into a single story. Two readings survive: the feature is genuinely inferential and beyond current automatic detection, or the rule's definition is not yet operational enough for any rater to apply consistently -- including the human. Distinguishing them needs a second independent human rater, which this report does not have and therefore does not claim.

articles.titleCn: 基于规则标注和大型语言模型在推论性叙事特征上的评分者间信度：基于土耳其语语料库的三项研究
articles.abstractCn: 自动生成的特征标注数据集会引发一个很少被问到的问题：人类是否会认同这些标签？本报告针对Objective Projection语料库（一个土耳其叙事数据集，其场景包含基于规则检测器对六个创作特征——两项禁令（情感标注、明喻）和四项积极技巧（具体化隐喻、微观聚焦、时间锚点、氛围矛盾）的每场景应用规则字段）回答了这个问题。报告记录了三项研究。研究1（$n = 120$）将检测器与该方案作者提供的盲标签进行评分。研究2（$n = 100$，一个独立的场景集）将检测器与Gemini 2.5 Flash和Grok评分，对象是独立非专家评分员，其标签在任何机器运行前已锁定。研究2b重复运行了相同的协议，使用Claude Fable 5（高）和ChatGPT 5.5。核心结果涉及一条规则。在具体化隐喻——最接近方法论理论核心的规则上，五个机器标注器在100个场景中返回的阳性率为0、1、40、72和78，而人类计数为9。对于六个标注器中的五个，在两种人类参考和两种场景集中，Cohen's $κ$值等于或无法区分于偶然性：0.004、0.015、0.000、0.019、0.027。原始一致性在74.7%到84.5%之间，这是类别不平衡的产物，而非能力的迹象。我们故意不将其归结为单一故事。两种解读得以留存：该特征确实具有推论性且超出现有自动检测能力，或该规则的界定尚未足够成熟，以至于任何评分员（包括人类）都无法一致应用。区分它们需要第二个独立的人类评分员，本报告没有这样的评分员，因此也不声称。

articles.title: North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation (Cohere CAT+)
articles.abstract: We present North Small Translate, an open-weight, LLM-based machine translation (MT) model with instruction-following capabilities built on the same foundation as Cohere's Command A Plus, a mixture-of-experts architecture with 25 billion active parameters out of 218 billion total parameters. North Small Translate is trained using difficulty sampling to obtain challenging documents and a five-step training protocol combining supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and online reinforcement learning. We prioritized throughput through a non-reasoning base model and supplemented with optional agentic capabilities to unlock translation quality gains. North Small Translate is trained to perform MT-related tasks, including post-editing and quality estimation, as well as related tasks such as general instruction following. The model achieves top MT performance across 50 languages in the class of models under 1T parameters, with no need to run expensive reasoning at inference time.
articles.titleCn: 北小翻译：高级经济型翻译 (Cohere CAT+)
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了North Small Translate，这是一个开放权重、基于LLM的机器翻译（MT）模型，具备指令遵循能力，其基础与Cohere的Command A Plus相同，后者是一种专家混合架构，拥有2180亿总参数中的250亿活跃参数。North Small Translate通过难度采样训练以获取具有挑战性的文档，并采用结合监督微调、直接偏好优化和在线强化学习的五步训练协议。我们通过非推理基础模型优先提高吞吐量，并辅以可选的代理能力来解锁翻译质量提升。North Small Translate被训练用于执行MT相关任务，包括后期编辑和质量评估，以及一般指令遵循等相关任务。该模型在参数量低于1T的模型类别中，在50种语言上实现了顶尖的MT性能，且推理时无需运行昂贵的推理过程。

articles.title: Phorecaster365: A Human-Supervised Reference Architecture for Hybrid Pharmaceutical Sales Forecasting and Planning Decision Support
articles.abstract: Pharmaceutical sales forecasts inform planning across products, regions, and distribution channels, yet their interpretation depends on inventory availability, transaction semantics, product lifecycle, and the information available when each forecast is issued. A model prediction alone does not preserve these conditions or establish whether a forecast is suitable for operational use. We present Phorecaster365, a human-supervised reference architecture that connects enterprise resource planning data to reviewable pharmaceutical sales forecasts. The architecture separates source ingestion, product-region series construction, temporally valid feature generation, statistical and machine-learning modeling, ensemble formation, uncertainty assessment, planner review, and lifecycle governance. Its central intermediate representation is a forecast context package that preserves the source snapshot, forecast target, temporal cutoff, available covariates, data-quality state, and hierarchy version. A corresponding forecast evidence package links predictions to model and calibration versions, exceptions, human adjustments, and publication history. Development experience with a synthetic panel of 10,950 daily records across 30 product-region series informs the design. Historical experiment summaries are retained only as descriptive evidence of development because their evaluation does not establish independent predictive validity. We specify a rolling-origin evaluation protocol, baseline and ablation requirements, uncertainty and robustness assessments, and a staged pathway from synthetic testing to use in governed planning. The contribution is an implementation-neutral system design and validation framework; the report does not establish real-world forecasting accuracy, comparative superiority, or operational benefit.

articles.titleCn: Phorecaster365：一种用于混合药品销售预测与规划决策支持的人监督参考架构
articles.abstractCn: 药品销售预测为产品、区域和分销渠道的规划提供信息，但其解读依赖于库存可用性、交易语义、产品生命周期以及每次预测发布时可用信息。仅有的模型预测无法保留这些条件或确定预测是否适用于运营使用。我们提出了Phorecaster365，这是一个由人工监督的参考架构，它将企业资源规划数据连接到可审查的药品销售预测。该架构将源数据摄取、产品-区域序列构建、时间有效特征生成、统计和机器学习建模、集成形成、不确定性评估、规划者审查和生命周期治理进行分离。其中心中间表示是一个预测上下文包，该包保留了源快照、预测目标、时间截止点、可用协变量、数据质量状态和层次版本。相应的预测证据包将预测与模型和校准版本、异常、人工调整和发布历史相关联。使用10,950条每日记录的合成面板（跨越30个产品-区域序列）的开发经验指导了设计。历史实验总结仅作为开发过程的描述性证据保留，因为它们的评估并未建立独立的预测有效性。我们指定了滚动原点评估协议、基线和消融要求、不确定性和鲁棒性评估，以及从合成测试到受控规划使用的分阶段路径。贡献是一个与实现无关的系统设计和验证框架；报告并未建立现实世界的预测准确性、比较优越性或运营效益。

articles.title: URCHIN: A Horizontal Spiking Language Model for Data-Constrained Pretraining
articles.abstract: The BabyLM challenge measures how much language a model can learn from developmentally-plausible, child-scale data rather than internet-scale corpora, yet prior language models forgo the biological constraints of the neural circuitry that acquires human language: spiking neurons separated into excitatory and inhibitory populations wired by a recurrent lateral connectome. This paper presents URCHIN (Unified Recurrent Connectome with Horizontal Integrate-and-fire Neurons), which applies the Parallelized Hierarchical Connectome Spiking State-space Model (PHCSSM) to language modeling: leaky integrate-and-fire neurons coupled by a Dale's-law lateral connectome resolve each token through a multi-transmission loop that recirculates activity to a fixed point. The instantiation is deliberately minimal: a single horizontal layer of 128 neurons, no attention, and 4.23M parameters. Two implementations share one set of weights and produce identical benchmark scores, so URCHIN is trained once and deployed either way with no conversion step: a parallel state-space model (SSM) scan that is GPU-efficient for training, or an event-driven recurrent spiking neural network (RSNN) with constant-cost inference for CPU or neuromorphic edge deployment. Across all three BabyLM tracks (Strict-100M, Strict-Small, and Multilingual), URCHIN offers a biologically plausible, efficient, and directly deployable reference point.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the BabyLM Challenge 2026 (BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026)
articles.titleCn: 海胆：一种用于数据受限预训练的水平脉冲语言模型
articles.abstractCn: BabyLM挑战衡量模型从发展上合理、儿童规模数据中学习语言的能力，而非互联网规模语料库，但先前的语言模型忽略了人类语言习得过程中神经回路的生物学约束：由兴奋性和抑制性种群分离的脉冲神经元，通过递归侧向连接组相互连接。本文提出了urchin（统一递归连接组，包含水平整合与点火神经元），将并行分层连接组脉冲状态空间模型（PHCSSM）应用于语言建模：通过戴尔定律侧向连接组耦合的漏电整合点火神经元，通过多传输循环解析每个标记，该循环将活动循环至固定点。实例化设计得极为简洁：单层128个神经元，无注意力机制，参数量为4.23M。两种实现共享同一组权重，产生相同的基准分数，因此urchin只需训练一次，即可根据需要部署：一种为并行状态空间模型（SSM）扫描，训练时对GPU高效；另一种为事件驱动递归脉冲神经网络（RSNN），具有恒定成本推理，适用于CPU或神经形态边缘部署。在所有三个BabyLM赛道（严格-1亿、严格-小型和多语言）中，urchin提供了一个生物学合理、高效且可直接部署的参考基准。

articles.title: SHIFT-M3: Pre-fusion Alignment-based Consistency Screening for Multimodal ECG Record Integrity
articles.abstract: Multimodal clinical AI typically assumes that the waveform, report, metadata, and downstream predictions attached to a record belong to the same patient. In practice, linkage failures can silently assemble individually plausible but cross-patient components, creating a safety problem that standard predictive models are not designed to detect. We study this problem as multimodal record integrity triage: given an assembled record, should its modalities be trusted to belong together? We introduce SHIFT-M3, a lightweight text-based pre-fusion screen that measures alignment-based consistency between two separately produced ECG text views: an LLM-generated interpretation and a clinical report summary. On 784,680 MEETI ECG records, SHIFT-M3 achieves 97.6% TPR@5% FPR for full text-view swaps (AUROC 0.996), 90.3% for partial swaps (AUROC 0.974), and 97.7% for label-matched hard negatives (AUROC 0.996) with only 573,569 parameters. Compared with same-dataset lexical baselines, the gains are largest on partial swaps and hard negatives, suggesting that the model is learning more than surface overlap. We also introduce the CMST (Conflict-type Multimodal Stress Test) evaluation taxonomy, a three-seed stability study, a loss ablation, a temporal-tolerance sweep, and a shared-token masking control. The main remaining failure mode is longitudinal ambiguity: at the default operating point, same-patient cross-visit pairs still produce 87.0% Type-II false positives.

articles.titleCn: SHIFT-M3：基于预融合对齐的多模态心电图记录一致性筛选
articles.abstractCn: 多模态临床AI通常假设记录中附带的波形、报告、元数据和下游预测属于同一患者。但在实际操作中，关联失败可能导致单独看似合理但跨患者的数据组件被无声地组合在一起，从而产生标准预测模型无法检测的安全问题。我们研究这一问题，将其定义为多模态记录完整性筛选：给定一个已组合的记录，其模态是否可信地属于同一患者？我们引入了SHIFT-M3，这是一种轻量级的基于文本的预融合筛选方法，用于测量两个分别生成的ECG文本视图之间的基于对齐的一致性：一个由LLM生成的解释和一个临床报告摘要。在784,680条MEETI ECG记录上，SHIFT-M3对全文视图交换实现了97.6%的TPR@5% FPR（AUROC 0.996），对部分交换实现了90.3%（AUROC 0.974），对标签匹配的硬负样本实现了97.7%（AUROC 0.996），仅需573,569个参数。与同数据集的词汇基线相比，在部分交换和硬负样本上的增益最大，表明模型在学习远超表面重叠的内容。我们还引入了CMST（冲突类型多模态压力测试）评估分类法、三种子稳定性研究、损失消融、时间容忍度扫描和共享标记掩码控制。主要的剩余失败模式是纵向模糊性：在默认操作点下，同一患者的跨访问对仍会产生87.0%的II型假阳性。

articles.title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
articles.abstract: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high annotation reliability reflected by a Fleiss\' Kappa of 0.82. Furthermore, we evaluate multiple feature representations, including Bag-of-Words (BoW), TF-IDF, and Word2Vec, with several classical machine learning classifiers. In addition, two heterogeneous ensemble models, namely Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE), are utilized to improve classification performance. Experimental results show that TF-IDF consistently outperforms Word2Vec, likely due to its ability to emphasize discriminative lexical cues associated with sentence functions, particularly given the relatively small corpus used to train Word2Vec. The DLE model with TF-IDF features achieves the best performance with accuracy and macro-F1 of 0.95, demonstrating the effectiveness of sparse lexical representations and heterogeneous ensemble learning for this task. Further cross-validation confirms the robustness of the approach, while LIME-based interpretability provides insights into model predictions. The developed corpus and model benchmarking establish strong baselines for Bangla sentence function classification.
