articles.titleCn: 孟加拉语句子功能分类：语料库开发、模型基准测试和可解释性
articles.abstractCn: 自动句子功能识别对许多下游自然语言处理（NLP）应用，如对话系统、文本到语音合成和机器翻译，都至关重要。然而，孟加拉语句子功能分类的基准资源仍然有限。为了弥补这一差距，本文介绍了一个包含10,000个孟加拉语句子的语料库，这些句子被手动标注为四个功能类别，即陈述句、疑问句、祈使句和感叹句。该语料库在四个类别中几乎平衡，高标注可靠性由0.82的Fleiss' Kappa反映。此外，我们评估了多种特征表示，包括词袋（BoW）、TF-IDF和Word2Vec，以及几种经典的机器学习分类器。此外，还利用了两种异构集成模型，即单级集成（SLE）和双级集成（DLE），以提高分类性能。实验结果表明，TF-IDF始终优于Word2Vec，这可能是由于其能够强调与句子功能相关的区分性词汇线索，尤其是在用于训练Word2Vec的相对较小的语料库中。使用TF-IDF特征的DLE模型取得了最佳性能，准确率和宏观F1分数达到0.95，证明了稀疏词汇表示和异构集成学习在该任务中的有效性。进一步的交叉验证确认了该方法的有效性，而基于LIME的可解释性为模型预测提供了洞察。开发的语料库和模型基准测试为孟加拉语句子功能分类建立了强大的基线。

articles.title: ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information
articles.abstract: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. To address this, we introduce ClinAgent, a conversational system based on agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that enables clinicians and researchers to query clinical trial information in plain language and receive grounded, up-to-date responses across multi-turn interactions. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a ClinicalTrials.gov search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). Results reveal complementary strengths, with DeepSeek (thinking mode) excelling in planning quality, while Gemini achieves the highest overall performance and strongest expert ratings. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of agentic AI systems to improve the accessibility and synthesis of clinical trial information, supporting more efficient and user-centered biomedical research workflows.
articles.titleCn: ClinAgent：一种基于ReAct的用于对话式获取临床试验信息的智能体
articles.abstractCn: 查询临床试验注册库仍然是一个手动且容易出错的流程，需要研究人员在缺乏自然语言交互或跨源综合支持的情况下处理大量半结构化数据。为解决这一问题，我们引入了ClinAgent，一个基于代理式检索增强生成（RAG）的对话系统，使临床医生和研究人员能够使用普通语言查询临床试验信息，并在多轮交互中接收基于事实的、最新的响应。该系统以遵循ReAct范式的通用语言模型（LLM）代理为核心，该代理会迭代地推理查询，从一组集成工具中进行选择，并根据中间输出调整其行动。这些工具包括ClinicalTrials.gov搜索界面、PubMed模块，以及一个基于Python的分析器，该分析器在本地缓存的临床试验结构化数据集上运行。我们使用一个包含三个阶段的框架来评估该系统，该框架评估操作有效性、规划质量、工具使用效率和专家定性判断，并比较了三个LLM后端：Gemini 3.0 Flash和DeepSeek V3.2的两个变体（思考和非思考）。结果表明存在互补优势，DeepSeek（思考模式）在规划质量方面表现优异，而Gemini实现了最高整体性能和最强的专家评价。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明代理式人工智能系统在提高临床试验信息的可访问性和综合方面的潜力，支持更高效、以用户为中心的生物医学研究工作流程。

articles.title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Enterprise customer support systems must answer customer questions correctly, retrieve the right policy information, use customer context, and pass difficult cases to human agents when needed. This paper presents ShopEase, a Generative AI-based multi-agent framework for enterprise customer support. The system combines six components: Intent, CRM, Memory, Hybrid RAG, Escalation, and Supervisor, and uses LLaMA 3.2 running locally through Ollama for response generation. The retrieval module combines FAISS (dense retrieval) and BM25 (sparse retrieval), and six configurations are evaluated: BM25-only, FAISS-only, Fair RRF, Weighted RRF, RRF with Cross-Encoder, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder. Instead of using a fixed mapping between intent and policy, the policy category is decided directly from the retrieved documents. The system was evaluated on 2632 held-out customer queries across six categories: Refund, Return, Shipping, Cancellation, Damaged Product, and Unknown. FAISS-only achieved the highest accuracy of 85.37\% (2247 correct predictions), closely followed by Weighted RRF at 85.07\%. BM25-only achieved only 55.74\% accuracy. Adding cross-encoder reranking did not improve results: RRF with Cross-Encoder reached 83.24\%, and Top-10 Hybrid with Cross-Encoder reached 81.88\%, while also increasing response latency. Category-level analysis shows strong performance on Shipping, Cancellation, and Return, while Unknown queries remain the main source of errors. Statistical testing using McNemar's test shows no significant difference between FAISS-only and Weighted RRF, though both perform significantly better than Fair RRF and the cross-encoder configurations. Overall, dense retrieval gives the best accuracy on this dataset, and additional reranking adds processing time without improving classification performance.
articles.titleCn: ShopEase：一种基于生成式人工智能的多智能体框架，用于混合检索增强生成技术的智能企业客户支持
articles.abstractCn: 企业客户支持系统必须准确回答客户问题，检索正确的政策信息，利用客户上下文，并在需要时将疑难案件转交给人工客服。本文介绍了ShopEase，一个基于生成式AI的企业客户支持多智能体框架。该系统结合了六个组件：意图、CRM、记忆、混合RAG、升级和监督者，并通过Ollama本地运行LLaMA 3.2进行响应生成。检索模块结合了FAISS（密集检索）和BM25（稀疏检索），并评估了六种配置：仅BM25、仅FAISS、公平RRF、加权RRF、带交叉编码器的RRF以及带交叉编码器的Top-10混合。系统不再使用意图和政策之间的固定映射，而是直接从检索到的文档中确定政策类别。系统在六个类别的2632个保留客户查询上进行了评估：退款、退货、运输、取消、损坏产品和不明确。仅FAISS达到了最高的85.37%准确率（2247个正确预测），紧随其后的是加权RRF的85.07%。仅BM25的准确率仅为55.74%。添加交叉编码器重新排序并未改善结果：带交叉编码器的RRF达到了83.24%，而带交叉编码器的Top-10混合达到了81.88%，同时增加了响应延迟。类别级分析显示在运输、取消和退货方面表现强劲，而不明确的查询仍然是错误的主要来源。使用McNemar检验的统计测试显示，FAISS-仅和加权RRF之间没有显著差异，尽管两者都显著优于公平RRF和交叉编码器配置。总体而言，密集检索在这个数据集上给出了最佳准确率，而额外的重新排序增加了处理时间而没有提高分类性能。

articles.title: Measuring the Cost of Variety Conflation in Multilingual MT Evaluation: Adding Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja and Sena to FLORES+
articles.abstract: In this paper, we extend FLORES+ with Portuguese-source evaluation sets for three Mozambican Bantu varieties: Xichangana, Mozambican Nyanja, and Sena. We compare Xichangana with the existing Tsonga reference and Mozambican Nyanja with Chichewa, and evaluate NLLB-200, Google Translate, GPT, and a variant-aware NLLB model. Holding system output fixed reveals substantial reference sensitivity. On \textit{devtest}, changing only the reference from Tsonga to Xichangana reduces spBLEU by 13.10 points for NLLB-200 and 15.30 for Google. On matched Nyanja subsets, replacing Chichewa with Mozambican Nyanja produces smaller but consistent reductions of 3.03 and 6.10 spBLEU, respectively. Variant-aware fine-tuning reverses this pattern on the intended targets: relative to NLLB-200, it improves Xichangana by 7.04 spBLEU and Mozambican Nyanja by 5.33 on \textit{devtest}, while losing performance on the sibling references. GPT is competitive on Tsonga and Chichewa but substantially weaker on the Mozambican varieties. For Sena, the finetuned model reaches 12.64 spBLEU and 36.21 chrF++ on \textit{devtest}. These findings motivate variety-aware language identifiers, references, and reporting for cross-border languages or language dialects/variants. The data is publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MOZNLP/FLORES_MOZ
articles.titleCn: 在多语言MT评估中衡量种类混淆的成本：将莫桑比克的希昌加纳语、尼亚尼亚语和塞纳语添加到FLORES+
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们为三种莫桑比克班图语系语言——希昌加纳语、莫桑比克尼亚尼亚语和塞纳语——扩展了FLORES+，并添加了葡萄牙语源的评估集。我们将希昌加纳语与现有的汤加语参考语料进行比较，将莫桑比克尼亚尼亚语与奇切瓦语进行比较，并评估了NLLB-200、谷歌翻译、GPT以及一个变体感知的NLLB模型。固定系统输出后，我们发现参考语料具有显著敏感性。在devtest集上，仅将参考语料从汤加语改为希昌加纳语，NLLB-200的spBLEU得分降低了13.10分，谷歌翻译降低了15.30分。在匹配的尼亚尼亚语子集上，用莫桑比克尼亚尼亚语替换奇切瓦语产生了较小但一致的spBLEU得分降低，分别为3.03分和6.10分。变体感知的微调在目标语言上逆转了这一模式：相对于NLLB-200，它在devtest集上使希昌加纳语提高了7.04 spBLEU，使莫桑比克尼亚尼亚语提高了5.33 spBLEU，但在兄弟参考语料上性能下降。GPT在汤加语和奇切瓦语上具有竞争力，但在莫桑比克语系语言上明显较弱。对于塞纳语，微调模型在devtest集上达到了12.64 spBLEU和36.21 chrF++。这些发现为跨境语言或语言方言/变体的语言变体感知标识符、参考语料和报告提供了启示。这些数据可在Hugging Face上公开获取，网址为https://huggingface.co/datasets/MOZNLP/FLORES_MOZ。

articles.title: Affinity-Aware Sharding for Delayed Tensor Parallelism
articles.abstract: Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP) removes the blocking all-reduce of tensor-parallel Transformer inference. Every device adds its own partial output to its residual stream (and broadcasts it) immediately, but only gathers (receives) the other devices' partials $δ$ modules later. A TP to DTP change therefore amounts to a real architecture change, and dense Transformer models need to be retrained or distilled after adaptation. We show that DTP breaks the permutation symmetry of neurons inside FFNs and of KV heads inside attention modules, and that this symmetry breakage makes the sharding itself a modelling decision. We show that maximising the affinity between the KV heads and the FFN neurons co-located on a device, by permuting the dense model before sharding, speeds up the distillation or retraining process. The affinity is measured with a first-order approximation of the damage that losing a head's contribution does to each neuron's output, and the co-located affinity is maximised with a coordinate-ascent optimiser that alternates an exact balanced assignment of neurons with an exhaustive search over the KV head partitions. The whole procedure takes under two minutes on one GPU for Qwen3-0.6B and Danube3-500M. On these models, at $δ=1$, the affinity-optimised layouts reach any distillation target in about half to two thirds of the steps needed by the naive contiguous layouts, over the whole 10k-step range we tested, and every optimised seed beats every contiguous seed and all but one of the sixteen random layouts. We also show that the co-located affinity score at initialisation predicts the KL to the base model after training, across seventeen layouts ranging from anti-optimised to optimised (Pearson $-0.81$ and $-0.89$).
articles.titleCn: 延迟张量并行计算的亲和性感知分片
articles.abstractCn: 延迟张量并行（DTP）消除了张量并行Transformer推理中的阻塞全归约操作。每个设备立即将其自身的部分输出添加到其残差流（并广播），但稍后才收集（接收）其他设备的部分输出δ模块。因此，从TP到DTP的转换实际上是一种架构变更，密集Transformer模型在适配后需要重新训练或蒸馏。我们证明DTP打破了FFN内部神经元和注意力模块内部KV头的置换对称性，并且这种对称性的破坏使得分片本身成为一种建模决策。我们证明，通过在分片前对密集模型进行置换，最大化设备上共位的KV头和FFN神经元之间的亲和力，可以加速蒸馏或重新训练过程。亲和力通过衡量失去一个头的贡献对每个神经元输出的损害的一阶近似来测量，而共位亲和力通过交替使用精确平衡分配神经元和全面搜索KV头分区的坐标上升优化器来最大化。对于Qwen3-0.6B和Danube3-500M模型，整个流程在单个GPU上不到两分钟。在这些模型上，当δ=1时，亲和力优化的布局在全10k步范围内，达到任何蒸馏目标所需的步骤大约是朴素连续布局所需步骤的一半到三分之二，并且每个优化种子都击败了每个连续种子和除了十六个随机布局中的一个之外的所有布局。我们还证明，初始共位亲和力分数可以预测训练后的KL散度，跨越从反优化到优化的十七种布局（Pearson -0.81和-0.89）。

articles.title: Sweet Talkers: How Query Formulation Shapes Sycophancy in Romantic Relationship Advice
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support and relationship advice, where a model's tendency to preserve a user's face can inadvertently reinforce harmful interpersonal behaviors. To systematically examine this risk, we developed the Romantic Relationship Advice-Seeking Prompts (RRASP) dataset of 2,400 prompts across five relationship themes and evaluated social sycophancy using the ELEPHANT framework on two consumer-facing models, GPT-5 Mini and Gemini 3 Flash. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, grammatical mood alone did not produce systematic differences in sycophantic behavior, suggesting that what a user implies matters more than how they phrase it. Instead, perspective-driven framing had a stronger influence, with gaps between original and flipped prompts widening in follow-up responses. Consistent increases in framing and moral sycophancy across turns indicate that models become more likely to accept a user's stated premises and affirm their ethical stance as a dialogue progresses. Notably, Gemini 3 Flash exhibited substantially smaller increases in moral sycophancy than GPT-5 Mini, suggesting it is more resistant to reinforcing ethically problematic positions across turns.
articles.titleCn: 甜言蜜语：查询措辞如何塑造浪漫关系建议中的谄媚
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于提供情感支持和关系建议，而模型维护用户面子的倾向可能会无意中强化有害的人际交往行为。为了系统地评估这一风险，我们开发了包含五个关系主题下2400个提示的浪漫关系建议寻求提示（RRASP）数据集，并使用ELEPHANT框架对两个面向消费者的模型GPT-5 Mini和Gemini 3 Flash进行了社交奉承评估。与我们的初始假设相反，语法语气本身并未产生系统性的奉承行为差异，表明用户暗示的内容比其措辞方式更重要。相反，以视角驱动的框架具有更强的影响力，在后续回应中，原始提示与翻转提示之间的差距逐渐扩大。随着对话的进行，框架和道德奉承的增加保持一致，表明模型更倾向于接受用户的既定前提并肯定其道德立场。值得注意的是，Gemini 3 Flash在道德奉承方面的增幅远小于GPT-5 Mini，表明它在对话中更不易强化存在道德问题的立场。

articles.title: When Consistency Does Not Mean Reliability: Evaluating Local LLM Judges Against Human Ratings
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate the responses of other language models. This approach, known as LLM-as-a-Judge, is faster and cheaper than human evaluation. However, a judge may produce consistent scores without necessarily agreeing with human evaluators. In this work, we study this issue using two local open-weight LLM judges, LLaMA-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B. We evaluate 300 responses generated by an instruction-tuned GPT-2 (124M) model for 100 questions covering five categories: factual knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, reasoning, and writing. Each response is scored by nine human annotators and is evaluated three times by each LLM judge using the same rubric. We compare the judge scores with the average human scores using Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, mean absolute error (MAE), signed bias, and self-consistency. LLaMA-3-8B shows a Pearson correlation of 0.275 with human scores, while Qwen2.5-7B achieves 0.340. Their MAEs are 27.71 and 18.64, respectively. Despite this limited agreement, both judges show high self-consistency, with exact consistency rates of 97.3\% for LLaMA-3-8B and 92.3\% for Qwen2.5-7B. These results show that high self-consistency does not necessarily indicate high agreement with human judgments. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate both consistency and human alignment when using local LLMs as automatic judges.
articles.titleCn: 当一致性不等于可靠性：评估本地LLM裁判与人类评分
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于评估其他语言模型的响应。这种方法被称为“LLM作为裁判”，比人工评估更快、更便宜。然而，裁判可能在没有必然与人工评估者达成一致的情况下给出一致的分数。在这项工作中，我们使用两个本地开源权重LLM裁判——LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B——来研究这个问题。我们评估了由指令微调的GPT-2（124M）模型生成的300个响应，这些响应涵盖了五个类别：事实知识、指令遵循、数学、推理和写作。每个响应由九个人工标注者评分，并由每个LLM裁判使用相同的评分标准进行三次评估。我们使用皮尔逊相关系数、斯皮尔曼相关系数、平均绝对误差（MAE）、符号偏差和自洽性来比较裁判分数与平均人工分数。LLaMA-3-8B与人工分数的皮尔逊相关系数为0.275，而Qwen2.5-7B达到了0.340。它们的MAE分别为27.71和18.64。尽管存在有限的共识，但两个裁判都表现出很高的自洽性，LLaMA-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B的精确一致性率分别为97.3%和92.3%。这些结果表明，高自洽性并不一定意味着与人工判断高度一致。我们的研究强调了在使用本地LLM作为自动裁判时，需要同时评估一致性和与人工的符合性。

articles.title: DARE: Dialectical Agentic Reasoning for Structured Knowledge Fact Checking
articles.abstract: Structured knowledge fact checking aims to determine the truthfulness of natural language claims by reasoning over structured evidence. Recent program-generation approaches leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate executable graph reasoning programs, achieving strong performance on structured knowledge fact checking benchmarks. However, these methods remain limited by invalid relation generation, single-path reasoning that lacks self-correction, and biased evidence assessment that tends to overestimate supporting signals. We propose Dialectical Agentic Reasoning (DARE), a multi-agent framework that formulates structured knowledge fact checking as an iterative retrieve-reason-reflect process. DARE integrates relation-grounded evidence retrieval to constrain reasoning to valid structures, dialectical bidirectional verification to evaluate evidence from both supporting and refuting perspectives, and confidence-driven meta-reflection to dynamically determine whether additional evidence exploration is necessary. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DARE in structured knowledge fact checking, with an 8B backbone achieving 88.12% accuracy and matching or surpassing GPT-4o-based program-generation baselines, which attests to the efficacy of dialectical agentic reasoning in eliciting the latent reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
articles.titleCn: DARE：结构化知识事实核查的辩证能动推理
articles.abstractCn: 结构化知识事实核查旨在通过推理结构化证据来确定自然语言陈述的真伪。近期程序生成方法利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成可执行的图推理程序，在结构化知识事实核查基准测试中取得了优异性能。然而，这些方法仍受限于无效关系生成、缺乏自我修正的单路径推理以及倾向于高估支持信号的偏置证据评估。我们提出了辩证代理推理（DARE），这是一个多智能体框架，将结构化知识事实核查表述为迭代检索-推理-反思过程。DARE集成了基于关系证据检索来约束推理至有效结构、辩证双向验证来从支持和反驳角度评估证据，以及置信度驱动的元反思来动态确定是否需要额外证据探索。大量实验证明了DARE在结构化知识事实核查中的有效性，其中8B骨干模型达到了88.12%的准确率，并匹配或超越了基于GPT-4o的程序生成基线，这证实了辩证代理推理在激发LLMs潜在推理能力方面的有效性。

articles.title: Understanding the Limits of Agentic ICD Coding
articles.abstract: ICD-10-CM codes are alphanumeric codes used in the US to classify diagnoses and injuries for medical billing and epidemiological reporting. Standard ICD-10-CM benchmarks report aggregate metrics that obscure performance on complex coding scenarios. We evaluate neural, workflow, and agentic systems on a rarity-stratified set of MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and identify two orthogonal failure modes. Neural classifiers exhibit a 0.43 micro-F1 gap between rare and common codes. Workflow systems handle rare codes well but score near zero on injury and external cause codes that require multi-step guideline following. A tool-augmented agentic configuration with structured access to official ICD-10-CM reference materials recovers up to 0.34 micro-F1 on this subset. No single system dominates across all conditions.
articles.titleCn: 理解自主ICD编码的局限性
articles.abstractCn: ICD-10-CM编码是美国用于分类诊断和伤害的字母数字编码，用于医疗账单和流行病学报告。标准的ICD-10-CM基准报告汇总指标，掩盖了在复杂编码场景中的表现。我们在MIMIC-IV出院记录的稀有分层集中评估了神经、工作流和代理系统，并识别出两种正交的失效模式。神经分类器在稀有编码和常见编码之间表现出0.43微F1的差距。工作流系统处理稀有编码效果良好，但在需要多步指南遵循的伤害和外部原因编码上得分接近零。一个工具增强的代理配置，通过结构化访问官方ICD-10-CM参考材料，在这个子集上恢复了高达0.34微F1。没有单一系统在所有条件下都占主导地位。

articles.title: SyRHM: Symbolic-Language-Enhanced Reasoning with Associative Retrieval for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection
articles.abstract: Detecting harmful memes is critical for maintaining safe online communities. However, harmful intent is often implicit, arising from visual-textual incongruity and cultural stereotypes, which challenges existing multimodal detectors. We propose SyRHM, a framework that decomposes harmful meme detection into meaning-grounded retrieval and symbolic-language-enhanced multi-stage reasoning. SyRHM retrieves semantically related memes by parsing multimodal content into textual elements and descriptions, providing grounded context beyond surface-level similarity. Building on the retrieved context, SyRHM uses a translator stage to convert multimodal inputs into symbolic intermediate representations, and then performs multi-stage reasoning via planner and solver stages, enabling expressive and interpretable analysis of harmful intent. Experiments on FHM, HarM, and MultiOff demonstrate the effectiveness of SyRHM, achieving superior performance on most evaluation settings against multimodal and reasoning-based baselines, while providing reasoning traces for harmful content. The code is available at: https://github.com/Scabbards1500/SyRHM
articles.titleCn: SyRHM：基于联想检索的符号语言增强推理，用于零样本有害梗图检测
articles.abstractCn: 检测有害表情包对于维护安全的在线社区至关重要。然而，有害意图通常隐含于视觉文本不协调和文化刻板印象中，这对现有的多模态检测器提出了挑战。我们提出了SyRHM框架，将有害表情包检测分解为基于语义检索和符号语言增强的多阶段推理。SyRHM通过解析多模态内容为文本元素和描述来检索语义相关的表情包，提供超越表面相似性的基础上下文。基于检索到的上下文，SyRHM使用翻译阶段将多模态输入转换为符号中间表示，然后通过规划和求解阶段进行多阶段推理，实现有害意图的表达性和可解释性分析。在FHM、HarM和MultiOff上的实验展示了SyRHM的有效性，在大多数评估设置中优于多模态和推理基线，同时提供有害内容的推理轨迹。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/Scabbards1500/SyRHM

articles.title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging
articles.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are increasingly used to score open-ended generation, yet a judge's correlation with human ratings on its development set may not guarantee valid measurement when outputs are closely matched and human preferences are subjective. We study this failure mode through psychological depth in short stories. Seven human readers and an LLM-judge ensemble selected on the original scalar Psychological Depth Scale dataset ($ρ= 0.646$) evaluated 60 blinded, prompt-matched story pairs from GPT-5 vs.\ GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 vs.\ DeepSeek-V3. Human preferences showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was modestly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0--62.9\%), whereas DeepSeek-R1 trailed V3 (42.9\%), and inter-reader agreement was near chance (Krippendorff's $α= 0.070$), with within-reader consistency and recurring weighting patterns suggesting structured heterogeneity rather than random responding. The judge, by contrast, favored reasoning outputs in 89.0\% of dimension-level comparisons and 59 of 60 pairs on aggregate PDS, uniformly across all five evaluator configurations, and its scores were associated with surface features such as sentence length and lexical diversity. These results suggest that development-set performance is insufficient evidence for deployment validity on a shifted distribution, and that point-estimate judges can obscure the heterogeneity in subjective human evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 推理能否提升大型语言模型的心理深度？这取决于评判者是谁。
articles.abstractCn: LLM作为裁判的评估方法在开放式生成任务中应用日益广泛，但当输出内容高度相似且人类偏好具有主观性时，裁判与开发集上人类评分的相关性并不能保证有效测量。我们通过短篇小说的心理深度这一心理维度来研究这种失效模式。七位人类读者和一个基于原始心理深度量表数据集（相关系数ρ=0.646）筛选出的LLM裁判组合，对来自GPT-5与GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1与DeepSeek-V3的60对盲测、提示匹配的短篇故事进行了评估。人类偏好显示不出普遍的推理优势：GPT-5略微优于GPT-4o（60.0%--62.9%），而DeepSeek-R1落后于V3（42.9%），读者间的一致性接近随机水平（Krippendorff's α=0.070），读者内部的一致性和反复出现的权重模式表明存在结构化异质性而非随机反应。相比之下，裁判在89.0%的维度级比较和60对中的59对总体心理深度评分（PDS）中偏爱推理输出，且这种偏好在不同五种评估配置下保持一致，其评分与句子长度、词汇多样性等表面特征相关。这些结果表明，开发集上的表现不足以证明在偏移分布上的部署有效性，点估计裁判会掩盖主观人类评估中的异质性。

articles.title: Training Specialist Models without Reasoning Trajectories for Domain Expert Distillation
articles.abstract: Specialist distillation effectively transfers domain expertise to student models via teacher-generated reasoning trajectories. However, when these specialists are trained solely on question--answer pairs without explicit reasoning supervision, what governs the trajectories they generate? In this work, we show that specialist optimization implicitly selects from this latent trajectory space. To isolate and observe this latent distribution, we leverage student distillation not as a downstream goal, but as an agnostic probe---since students inherit no parameterization or optimization constraints from the specialist, inheriting only the sampled trajectories themselves. Through this probe, our empirical analysis unveils a tight governing relationship: across 27 specialist--student pairings, their specialization--generalization profiles correlate exceptionally strongly. Crucially, explicitly controlling the specialist's distributional drift systematically shifts both the teacher and its distilled student along a controllable trade-off between domain precision and general-capability retention. Across chemistry, physics, and multilingual settings, distilled students systematically reflect these specialist-induced profiles, even across divergent model families. Our findings establish a new view of specialist training: when gold reasoning is absent, tuning choices directly control the latent supervision passed to downstream models.
articles.titleCn: 为领域专家蒸馏而无需推理轨迹训练专业模型
articles.abstractCn: 专家蒸馏通过教师生成的推理轨迹有效地将领域专业知识迁移到学生模型中。然而，当这些专家仅通过问答对进行训练且缺乏明确的推理监督时，他们生成的轨迹受什么因素支配？在本工作中，我们表明专家优化会隐式地从潜在轨迹空间中进行选择。为了隔离并观察这种潜在分布，我们利用学生蒸馏，将其作为一种无偏探针——由于学生不会继承专家的参数化或优化约束，只会继承被采样的轨迹本身。通过这种探针，我们的实证分析揭示了一种紧密的支配关系：在27对专家-学生组合中，它们的专门化-泛化特征表现出极强的相关性。关键在于，通过显式控制专家的分布漂移，可以系统性地将教师及其蒸馏出的学生沿着可控的领域精确性与泛化能力保留之间的权衡进行移动。在化学、物理和多语言环境中，蒸馏出的学生系统性地反映了专家诱导的特征，即使在不同模型家族中也如此。我们的研究为专家训练建立了一种新视角：当黄金推理缺失时，调优选择会直接控制传递给下游模型的潜在监督。

articles.title: HyperProve: Answer-Guided Hypergraph Expansion for Multi-Hop Question Answering
articles.abstract: Multi-hop question answering often fails when retrieval treats evidence as isolated matches to the original question, since the facts needed to answer a complex question are usually connected through intermediate entities, relations, and constraints. We propose HyperProve, a retrieval-augmented QA framework that addresses this challenge by coupling question decomposition with answer-conditioned expansion over a hypergraph of atomic facts. HyperProve does not use atomic facts, hypergraphs, or iterative retrieval in isolation; instead, it carries intermediate answers and supporting hyperedges as retrieval state, then uses that state to bias the next local hypergraph expansion. This design enables HyperProve to construct coherent evidence chains for final answer generation while making the retrieval process stateful and fact-centered. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, HyperProve achieves the best overall performance in our evaluation, outperforming the strongest baselines by an average relative improvement of 6.2% in answer accuracy and 4.9% in F1.
articles.titleCn: HyperProve：用于多跳问答的答案引导超图扩展
articles.abstractCn: 多跳问答在检索将证据视为与原始问题孤立匹配时常常失败，因为回答复杂问题所需的 факты 通常通过中间实体、关系和约束相互连接。我们提出了 HyperProve，这是一个通过将问题分解与在原子事实超图上的答案条件扩展相结合的检索增强问答框架，以应对这一挑战。HyperProve 不单独使用原子事实、超图或迭代检索；相反，它将中间答案和支持超边作为检索状态，然后使用该状态来引导下一个局部超图扩展。这种设计使 HyperProve 能够为最终答案生成构建连贯的证据链，同时使检索过程状态化并以事实为中心。在我们的评估中，HyperProve 在多跳问答基准测试中实现了最佳整体性能，在答案准确率和 F1 上平均比最强基线提高了 6.2% 和 4.9%。

articles.title: Inside VLM Chart Reading: Tracing Value Reading from Vertical Bar Charts Across Space and Depth
articles.abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) can answer chart questions accurately, but output accuracy does not show how they combine the evidence needed to recover an exact value. We study vertical-bar value reading with controlled counterfactual activation patching in Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL3.5-8B. The study connects three analyses: (1) The single-factor results show that the changed bar-top region restores much more answer preference than the unchanged bar body, despite containing fewer visual tokens. Legend- and series-related states also lose local recoverability earlier than bar-geometry and axis-scale states. (2) In the handoff analysis, restoration shifts from visual legend regions in early layers to prompt-series positions in middle layers. Resetting the prompt-series state selectively reduces legend-source rescue, supporting its role as a partial mediator. (3) In the factorial analysis, both models can use geometry and scale states from separate donors to favor the combined target. InternVL performs similarly when the states come from separate donors or one image, while Qwen shows lower restoration for separate donors which suggests higher context sensitivity. Together, these results provide preliminary causal evidence for localizing the internal computations that support exact bar-value reading.
articles.titleCn: VLM图表阅读内部：追踪价值阅读从垂直条形图跨越空间和深度
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够准确回答图表问题，但其输出准确率并不能体现它们如何结合所需证据来恢复精确值。我们通过在Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct和InternVL3.5-8B中进行受控反事实激活补丁研究，探讨了垂直条形图的值读取。这项研究连接了三项分析：(1) 单因素结果表明，改变条形顶部区域比未改变的条形主体更能恢复答案偏好，尽管其包含的视觉标记更少。与条形几何和轴刻度状态相比，图例和系列相关的状态更早失去局部可恢复性。(2) 在交接分析中，恢复过程从早期层的视觉图例区域转移到中层提示-系列位置。重置提示-系列状态会选择性减少图例源救援，支持其作为部分中介的作用。(3) 在因素分析中，两个模型都能使用来自不同来源的几何和刻度状态来支持组合目标。InternVL在状态来自不同来源或同一图像时表现相似，而Qwen对分离来源的恢复较低，这表明其具有更高的上下文敏感性。这些结果共同为定位支持精确条形值读取的内部计算提供了初步的因果证据。

articles.title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.
articles.comment: 13 pages. Equal contribution: Hongliang Wei and Xiaobing Tu. Corresponding authors: Xiaobing Tu and Xiaopeng Fan
articles.titleCn: HarnessBandit：多套具身智能强化学习的联合学习性与迁移性调度
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理正越来越多地通过不同的框架部署，这些框架在系统提示、工具模式、控制循环和轨迹格式上有所不同。同一个模型在这些接口上的表现可能不均衡，因此对框架差异的鲁棒性成为一项重要目标。一种自然的方法是通过多个框架训练共享策略，但这会引入一个调度问题：每一步训练都应优先选择当前提供有用学习信号的框架，同时生成的更新也应有利于其他框架。我们开发了HarnessBandit，这是一个在线调度器，每个优化器步骤选择一个框架。在执行组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新后，它观察可学习性——批次上的平均绝对优势——以及可迁移性——当前框架的低维梯度草图与剩余框架指数移动平均值的余弦值。这两个信号在经过池化滑动窗口最小-最大归一化后融合，并使用基于访问次数的奖励和显式探索下限进行采样。我们在ClawGym上通过六个框架训练Qwen3.5-2B，并在PinchBench（保留任务，分布内OpenClaw）和ClawEval（保留任务和框架）上进行评估。HarnessBandit在两个基准测试上都优于混合批次多框架训练，而训练诊断表明可学习性和可迁移性提供了不同且不断变化的信号。

articles.title: ForeSight: Enhancing Risk Monitoring via Early Safety Signal Distillation
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed, the generation of harmful content has become a critical safety concern. Existing safeguards operate at the input, output, or streaming-generation stages, while early-risk methods that rely on surface tokens or output logits may suffer from weak initial signals, and internals-based detectors using dense representations may retain highly entangled and redundant safety-irrelevant information. It therefore remains unclear whether the earliest post-generation hidden states already contain reliable signals about final-response harmfulness. To address this gap, we propose ForeSight, a first-token output-risk forecasting framework that distills weak and redundant early safety signals into compact, layer-aware risk representations. Experiments on five safety benchmarks and two target models demonstrate that ForeSight achieves superior and efficient early-risk forecasting while relying solely on first-token hidden states. The code is available at: https://github.com/Scabbards1500/Foresight
articles.comment: 17 pages, 12 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: ForeSight：通过早期安全信号提纯增强风险监测
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的日益部署，有害内容的生成已成为一个关键的安全问题。现有的安全防护措施在输入、输出或流式生成阶段进行操作，而依赖表面标记或输出logits的早期风险方法可能存在初始信号微弱的问题，而基于内部的检测器使用密集表示可能保留高度纠缠且与安全无关的冗余信息。因此，目前尚不清楚生成后的最早隐藏状态是否已包含关于最终响应有害性的可靠信号。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ForeSight，一个基于首个标记输出的风险预测框架，该框架将微弱且冗余的早期安全信号提炼为紧凑的、层级感知的风险表示。在五个安全基准和两个目标模型上的实验表明，ForeSight在仅依赖首个标记隐藏状态的情况下，实现了优越且高效的风险预测。代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/Scabbards1500/Foresight

articles.title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world high-stakes applications, effective governance has become essential. Existing safeguards largely follow two paradigms: learning-based guards provide strong semantic discrimination but couple policy behavior to trained models and taxonomies, while programmable frameworks offer flexible control but require substantial manual prompt and workflow engineering. Neither externalizes policies as reusable operational states, making it difficult to consistently reuse policy evidence across detection, intervention, and verification. In this paper, we introduce PolicyMem, a geometric policy memory that externalizes natural-language policies as reusable geometric memory objects represented by low-rank subspaces in a shared representation space. A memory writer compiles natural-language policies into policy memory slots, and query-response pairs read the policy memory through projection energy. The resulting policy-evidence profile directly mediates the safety verdict and is reused for policy attribution and post-intervention verification. Coupled with a response rewriter, PolicyMem enables a detect-rewrite-verify loop for LLM governance. Across five widely used benchmarks, PolicyMem achieves state-of-the-art unsafe behavior detection while enabling effective policy attribution, rewriting, and post-intervention verification through the shared policy memory.
articles.titleCn: PolicyMem：用于LLM治理的几何策略记忆
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于现实世界的高风险场景，有效的治理变得至关重要。现有的安全措施主要遵循两种范式：基于学习的防护措施提供了强大的语义区分能力，但将策略行为与训练模型和分类体系绑定；可编程框架提供了灵活的控制能力，但需要大量的人工提示和工作流工程。这两种方法都没有将策略作为可重用的操作状态进行外部化，导致在检测、干预和验证过程中难以一致地重用策略证据。在本文中，我们介绍了PolicyMem，一种几何策略存储器，它将自然语言策略外部化为可重用的几何内存对象，这些对象由共享表示空间中的低秩子空间表示。一个内存写入器将自然语言策略编译到策略内存插槽中，查询-响应对通过投影能量读取策略内存。生成的策略证据配置直接调解安全裁决，并用于策略归因和干预后验证。结合响应重写器，PolicyMem为LLM治理实现了一个检测-重写-验证循环。在五个广泛使用的基准测试中，PolicyMem在实现最先进的不安全行为检测的同时，通过共享策略内存实现了有效的策略归因、重写和干预后验证。

articles.title: Scaling Hindi Quantum Natural Language Processing through Automatic Pregroup Supertagging
articles.abstract: Quantum Natural Language Processing (QNLP) uses pregroup grammars to translate grammatical structure into diagrammatic representations and quantum circuits. Recent Hindi QNLP work has shown that Hindi-specific pregroup grammars can support grammar-sensitive compositional models, but grammatical type assignment is still largely manual, limiting scalability. This paper formulates automatic Hindi pregroup supertagging as a token-level classification task. Using a manually annotated corpus of 380 Hindi sentences, we evaluate lexical, contextual, prompting-based, lexical-repair, and suffix/morphology-aware methods. Results show that simple lexical and contextual models are strong in this low-resource setting: contextual backoff achieves the best completed accuracy of 64.56\%, while raw Qwen2.5 prompting reaches only 11.65\%. Lexical repair raises LLM-assisted prediction to 64.08\%, demonstrating the value of constraining generative outputs with symbolic grammar knowledge. Diagnostic analysis further shows that seen and unambiguous tokens are much easier than unseen tokens, and suffix/morphology features improve karaka-token accuracy but not overall performance. These results show that automatic Hindi pregroup assignment is feasible and can reduce reliance on manual annotation in future multilingual QNLP pipelines.
articles.titleCn: 通过自动预群超标签扩展印地语量子自然语言处理
articles.abstractCn: 量子自然语言处理（QNLP）使用预群文法将语法结构转化为图示表示和量子电路。最近的印地语QNLP研究表明，特定于印地语的预群文法可以支持语法敏感的组合模型，但语法类型分配仍主要依赖人工操作，限制了可扩展性。本文将自动印地语预群超标签化公式化为一个分词级别的分类任务。使用一个包含380个人工标注的印地语句子的语料库，我们评估了词汇、上下文、提示、词汇修复以及后缀/形态感知方法。结果表明，在低资源环境下，简单的词汇和上下文模型表现强劲：上下文回退达到了最高的完成准确率64.56%，而原始Qwen2.5提示仅达到11.65%。词汇修复将LLM辅助预测提升至64.08%，展示了通过符号文法知识约束生成输出的价值。诊断分析进一步表明，已见和明确的标记远比未见的标记容易，后缀/形态特征提高了karaka标记的准确率，但并未提升整体性能。这些结果表明，自动印地语预群分配是可行的，并可以在未来的多语言QNLP流程中减少对人工标注的依赖。

articles.title: When Edit Localization Amplifies Relative Selection Bias: Gradient Geometry, Target Mismatch, and Importance Weighting
articles.abstract: Human corrections identify editable spans, but the examples receiving corrections may come from a selective feedback channel. We analyze this interaction at a fixed model checkpoint by decomposing a localized gradient into edited and retained untouched components. Squared relative selection bias is a ratio of quadratics whose derivative has the sign of an explicit quadratic polynomial. Localization can increase, decrease, or nonmonotonically change this diagnostic; its direction depends on component biases and geometry. Oracle importance weighting recovers the population mean for each fixed localization objective, but these objectives have different targets. Against one common full-gradient target, we derive the finite-sample mean-squared error, an analytic optimal retention coefficient, and a fixed-clipping extension. Exact finite-population calculations and 10,000 Monte Carlo repetitions per sample size verify the identities and counterexamples. Public human-post-edit experiments use two translation directions and pretrained models, with declared synthetic selection. An English-German extension differentiates 73.89 million native parameters. In all three declared settings, hard localization has higher relative bias but lower absolute bias than full retention. Untouched-component biases are nonzero and selected component means have negative inner products, so the general criterion applies where the simple unbiased/aligned explanation fails. Output-bias diagnostics show the same endpoint ordering of relative bias across both directions, with one interior maximum. Mechanisms reuse each language's records and include a mixture; they are not independent replications. The evidence separates relative amplification from absolute gradient error and establishes estimation properties, without inferring translation-quality gains or identifying actual complaint propensities.
articles.titleCn: 当编辑本地化放大相对选择偏差：梯度几何、目标不匹配和重要性加权
articles.abstractCn: 人工校对能够识别可编辑的文本片段，但接收校对的示例可能来自有选择性的反馈渠道。我们通过将局部梯度分解为编辑和保留未修改的成分，在固定的模型检查点分析这种交互作用。平方相对选择偏差是一个导数具有显式二次多项式符号的二次比。局部化可以增加、减少或非单调地改变这种诊断指标；其方向取决于成分偏差和几何形状。奥рач重要性加权能够恢复每个固定局部化目标的总体均值，但这些目标具有不同的目标。针对一个常见的全梯度目标，我们推导出有限样本均方误差、解析最优保留系数和固定裁剪扩展。精确的有限总体计算和每个样本规模的10,000次蒙特卡洛重复验证了这些恒等式和反例。公开的人工后编辑实验使用两种翻译方向和预训练模型，并声明了合成选择。英语-德语扩展区分了7389万原生参数。在所有三个声明设置中，硬局部化比全保留具有更高的相对偏差但更低的绝对偏差。未修改成分的偏差不为零，且选定成分的均值具有负内积，因此当简单的无偏/对齐解释失效时，通用标准适用。输出偏差诊断在两个方向上显示出相同的相对偏差终点排序，并具有一个内部最大值。机制重用每种语言的记录并包含混合；它们不是独立的重复。证据将相对放大与绝对梯度误差区分开来，并建立了估计特性，而未推断翻译质量提升或识别实际投诉倾向。

articles.title: Prefix Sharing Is a Sorting Problem
articles.abstract: LLM serving reuses KV cache by exact prefix match, so when a prompt is assembled from a set of reusable pieces -- retrieved passages, tool definitions, few-shot exemplars -- the order chosen for those pieces determines how much computation can be shared. Every deployed system fixes that order by a single global convention. We prove this is optimal only when requests contain at most two pieces, and asymptotically wrong in general. Our main result is a structure theorem: the minimum prefix-trie cost equals min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H) over binary hierarchies H on the requests, where t_x(H) is the canonical decomposition size of the set of requests needing chunk x. Choosing chunk orders is therefore equivalent to choosing one hierarchy over requests. The identity yields an O(3^m) exact algorithm, identifies the two-chunk case as minimum vertex cover, and shows that on the leave-one-out family the optimum is the minimum external path length of a binary tree -- the merge-sort recursion -- so a global order pays Theta(n^2) against a true cost of Theta(n log n). Agglomerative clustering by common intersection is a tight 1/2-approximation for the achievable saving. On BM25 retrieval traces over three BEIR corpora the resulting layout reduces prefill by 17-36% against production RAG ordering, and the margin widens with retrieval depth as the theory predicts. Serving requests in the hierarchy's DFS order finally lets a cache holding one request's context attain the unbounded-cache optimum exactly, so cache capacity and reorder window act as substitutes.
articles.titleCn: 前缀共享是一个排序问题
articles.abstractCn: LLM服务通过精确前缀匹配重用KV缓存，因此当提示由一组可重用片段——检索到的段落、工具定义、少量示例——组装时，这些片段的选择顺序决定了可以共享多少计算量。每个部署的系统通过单一的全局约定来固定这个顺序。我们证明这只有在请求最多包含两个片段时才是最优的，并且在一般情况下是渐近错误的。我们的主要结果是结构定理：最小前缀树成本等于在请求上的二叉层次结构H上的min_H sum_x w(x) t_x(H)，其中t_x(H)是需要片段x的请求集合的经典分解大小。因此选择片段顺序相当于在请求中选择一个层次结构。这个恒等式产生了一个O(3^m)的精确算法，将两片段情况识别为最小顶点覆盖，并表明在留一法家族中，最优解是二叉树的最小外部路径长度——归并排序递归——因此全局顺序的代价为Theta(n^2)，而真实成本为Theta(n log n)。基于公共交集的聚合聚类是对可达到的节省的紧1/2近似。在BM25检索迹上，三个BEIR语料库的生产RAG顺序相比，结果布局减少了17-36%的预填充，并且随着检索深度增加，正如理论预测的那样，差距会扩大。最后，在层次结构的深度优先搜索顺序中服务请求，使得一个缓存持有单个请求的上下文恰好达到无界缓存的最优解，因此缓存容量和重排序窗口充当替代品。

articles.title: Not all Negation Cues are Equal: Affixal Negations Yield Better Negation Understanding
articles.abstract: Negation remains a longstanding challenge for both language models (LMs) and large language models (LLMs). Prior work mainly focuses on a small set of high-frequency single-word negation cues, such as not and never, with limited exploration of broader negation types and modern LLMs. To address this gap, we construct NegCue, a large-scale dataset containing over 1.8M samples spanning single-word, multi-word, and affixal negation with more than 200 unique cues. We further pre-train both encoder-only LMs and LLMs on NegCue to investigate how different negation types affect negation understanding. Experiments on five downstream benchmarks show that negation types contribute unevenly to performance gains under the same training scale. In particular, affixal negation yields the largest improvements, while the gains from the commonly studied single-word negation remain modest. Moreover, our results demonstrate that further pre-training improves negation understanding for both LMs and LLMs.
articles.comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
articles.titleCn: 并非所有否定线索都相同：词缀否定更能提升否定理解能力
articles.abstractCn: 否定仍然是对语言模型（LMs）和大型语言模型（LLMs）的一项长期挑战。以往的研究主要关注少数高频单字否定提示词，如not和never，而对更广泛的否定类型和现代LLMs的探索有限。为填补这一空白，我们构建了NegCue，一个包含超过180万样本的大规模数据集，涵盖了单字、多字和词缀否定，并包含200多种独特的提示词。我们进一步在NegCue上对编码器-only LM和LLMs进行预训练，以研究不同否定类型如何影响否定理解。在五个下游基准测试上的实验表明，在相同训练规模下，否定类型对性能提升的贡献并不均衡。特别是词缀否定带来了最大的改进，而通常研究的单字否定带来的增益仍然有限。此外，我们的结果表明，进一步的预训练能够提升LMs和LLMs的否定理解能力。

articles.title: LayerRoute: Adaptive Layer-Skipping with LoRA-Preserved Quality for Efficient LLM Inference
articles.abstract: We introduce LayerRoute, a parameter-efficient method for adaptive transformer layer-skipping that combines per-layer hard-gated routing (trained via a straight-through estimator) with joint LoRA fine-tuning. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with a lightweight per-layer router (~21.5K parameters) and LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters), training both jointly under a gate-regularized language-modeling objective. Across 10 independently-seeded training runs, LayerRoute converges to an identical skip-pattern structure in every run - a consistent set of 9 middle layers (8-16) becomes skip-eligible in all 10 seeds - and delivers genuine, verified wallclock speedup in every run (1.02x-1.06x, mean 1.04x). Quality is preserved or improved in every configuration tested: joint LoRA adaptation yields a perplexity improvement over the unmodified backbone in all 10 seeds (mean delta = -1.16 and -1.11 across the two evaluation splits used). We further verify the router performs genuine, non-trivial per-input computation: gate decisions in skip-eligible layers change the actual skip/run outcome for 87-100% of held-out samples, confirming real input-dependent routing rather than a fixed pruning pattern. LayerRoute trains in under 7 minutes on a single A100 and adds negligible overhead beyond the routing decision itself. We report our full reproducibility methodology, including a systematic diagnostic investigation into what determines the router's per-input decisions, as part of this work.
articles.titleCn: LayerRoute：基于LoRA保留质量的适应性层跳过技术，用于高效的大型语言模型推理
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了LayerRoute，这是一种参数高效的适应型Transformer层跳过方法，它结合了每层硬门控路由（通过直通估计器训练）和联合LoRA微调。LayerRoute为Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct中的每个24个Transformer块增加了一个轻量级的每层路由器（约21.5K参数）和LoRA适配器（秩8，约1.08M参数），并在门控正则化的语言模型目标下联合训练。在10次独立种子训练运行中，LayerRoute在每次运行中都收敛到相同的跳过模式结构——在所有10个种子中，始终有一组9个中间层（8-16）成为跳过候选层——并在每次运行中提供真实的、经过验证的时钟速度提升（1.02x-1.06x，平均1.04x）。在所有测试的配置中，质量都得到保留或提升：联合LoRA适配在所有10个种子中都比未修改的主干模型提供了困惑度改善（在两个使用的评估分割中，平均变化量分别为-1.16和-1.11）。我们进一步验证了路由器执行了真实的、非平凡的每输入计算：跳过候选层中的门控决策改变了87-100%的保留样本的实际跳过/运行结果，证实了真实的输入依赖路由，而不是固定的剪枝模式。LayerRoute在单个A100上训练时间不到7分钟，除了路由决策本身外，几乎没有额外的开销。我们报告了我们的完整可复现性方法，包括对决定路由器每输入决策因素的系统诊断研究，作为这项工作的部分内容。

articles.title: FedV-KGQA in Practice: Design Lessons and an Interactive Prototype
articles.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering usually assumes that one system can reach the whole graph. In practice, facts are often held by organizations that share entity identifiers but own disjoint relation types, so no single party sees a complete reasoning chain. This poster presents the empirical findings of FedV-KGQA on multi-hop question answering over such vertically partitioned graphs. Each silo enriches its local graph and trains a knowledge graph embedding on its own triples. A server then concatenates the silo-specific entity views, anchors the projected question at the topic entity, and ranks candidates by similarity. Raw triples and relation embeddings never leave a silo. Comparing the FedV-KGQA experiments with one another yields three results. First, federated fusion recovers most of the centralized accuracy, while a single silo recovers little. Second, anchoring and enrichment matter more than the choice of embedding model. Third, the cheapest encoder depends on the target accuracy rather than on parameter count. This poster paper contributes that cross-experiment comparison, four design lessons drawn from it, and an interactive prototype that runs real inference and traces the full pipeline, per question, on released checkpoints.
articles.comment: Accepted at the ISWC 2026 Posters and Demos Track; to appear in the ISWC 2026 Companion Volume (CEUR-WS)
articles.titleCn: FedV-KGQA实践：设计经验与交互原型
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱问答通常假设一个系统能够访问整个图谱。在实践中，事实通常由共享实体标识符但拥有不相交关系类型的组织持有，因此没有任何一方能看到完整的推理链。本海报展示了FedV-KGQA在垂直分区图谱上的多跳问答的实证发现。每个隔间（silo）都丰富其本地图谱，并在其三元组上训练知识图谱嵌入。然后，服务器将隔间特定的实体视图连接起来，将投影的问题锚定在主题实体上，并通过相似度对候选者进行排序。原始三元组和关系嵌入永远不会离开隔间。通过比较FedV-KGQA实验彼此的结果，得出三个结论。首先，联邦融合恢复了大部分的集中式准确率，而单个隔间恢复的很少。其次，锚定和丰富比嵌入模型的选择更重要。第三，最便宜的编码器取决于目标准确率而不是参数数量。本海报论文贡献了跨实验比较、从中得出的四个设计教训，以及一个交互式原型，该原型运行真实推理，并按问题追踪完整管道，使用发布的检查点。

articles.title: FaithfulBench: Does AI Counsel Uphold or Undermine the User's Professed Faith?
articles.abstract: Do AI assistants help believers reason about moral dilemmas consistently with their faith? We present FaithfulBench, the first benchmark to score AI counsel across traditions by how well it adheres to the user's professed faith. Scenarios are drawn from each tradition's most respected texts, with the faithful answer known and applied by the judges as the standard. We test five frontier models under three conditions: the AI does not know the user's tradition; it receives a one-line prompt identifying the user as a practicing adherent; or it receives a companion-counselor guide rooted in the tradition's sources. Two judges score the initial response and whether the model caves or holds when pressured toward the answer the user wants. When the tradition is unstated, models counsel from a secular therapeutic default and every model fails some believers. Naming the faith wins a faithful first answer but not steadfastness; the guide improves both.
articles.comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Open-source corpus, harness and validator at https://github.com/faithfamilytechnologynetwork/multibench; results browser at https://multibrowser-production.up.railway.app
articles.titleCn: FaithfulBench：人工智能咨询是否维护或削弱了用户所声称的信仰？
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能助手能否帮助信徒始终如一地根据其信仰来推理道德困境？我们介绍了FaithfulBench，这是首个通过评估人工智能建议在不同传统信仰体系中对用户宣称信仰的遵循程度来打分的基准。场景均源自各传统最受推崇的文本，其中忠实答案由评委知晓并作为标准应用。我们在三种条件下测试了五种前沿模型：人工智能不知道用户的传统；它收到一条识别用户为虔诚信徒的提示；或者它收到基于该传统来源的同伴咨询指南。两位评委对初始回应进行评分，并评估模型在受到压力要求给出用户期望答案时是屈服还是坚持。当传统未指明时，模型从世俗治疗默认角度提供建议，且所有模型都让部分信徒失望。明确信仰能赢得忠实的第一回应，但无法保证坚持；指南则能同时提升这两方面表现。

articles.title: An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.
articles.titleCn: 一种针对LLM的靶向性危害缓解的高效模块化框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是强大的零样本学习器，但仍然容易与人类偏好产生偏差，常常生成有偏见、有毒或其他有害的输出。现有的对齐方法虽然有效，但成本高昂且与模型紧密耦合，限制了灵活性和可扩展性。我们提出了一种模块化校正框架，通过添加激活型LoRA（aLoRA）适配器和上下文感知路由机制来增强预训练LLMs，以消除模型响应与预期不符带来的危害。我们的方法使专家适配器能够在生成过程中中途激活，而不会使KV缓存失效，从而实现低延迟、有针对性的校正。每个专家都经过训练，用于检测和减轻特定的危害，例如偏见或毒性。一个学习的路由器会根据模型的中间输出动态选择合适的专家。我们证明了我们的系统在标准安全基准上提高了对齐度，同时保留了任务性能，为更安全、更可控的LLM部署提供了一条轻量级且高效的路径。

articles.title: The University of Melbourne WMT 2026 CreoleMT Submission: A Domain-Balanced Approach to Low-Resource Pacific Creole Machine Translation
articles.abstract: For our submission to the WMT26 Creole Language Translation Shared Task, we focus on machine translation (MT) models for Pacific creoles: Tok Pisin, Bislama, and Solomon Pijin, with particular attention to broad domain performance. After pre-training on a large collection of domain-imbalanced data, we continue fine-tuning on a diverse mix of domain-balanced data. We rely on a number of data collection and preparation techniques, including LLM-assisted respelling and alignment, back-translation, and distillation from Gemini for domains originally not present in training data. Evaluated on Bouquet and a novel test set made of spoken language transcripts, our models beat open model baselines by 3+ chrF++ points in all directions with human-original references. Looking ahead, we plan to develop human-translated test sets for Solomon Pijin and Bislama, and to distil our best models into much smaller ones that retain broad domain coverage.
articles.titleCn: 墨尔本大学 WMT 2026 CreoleMT 提交：面向低资源太平洋克里奥尔机器翻译的领域平衡方法
articles.abstractCn: 针对我们提交给WMT26克里奥尔语言翻译共享任务的成果，我们专注于太平洋克里奥尔语（托克皮辛语、比斯拉马语和所罗门皮金语）的机器翻译（MT）模型，尤其关注通用领域的性能表现。在基于大量领域不平衡数据集进行预训练后，我们继续在领域平衡的多样化数据集上进行微调。我们采用了多种数据收集和准备技术，包括LLM辅助的拼写纠正与对齐、回译，以及从Gemini中提取知识以应对训练数据中原本不存在的领域。在Bouquet测试集和由口语转录文本构成的新测试集上的评估显示，我们的模型在所有方向上均以3+ chrF++的绝对优势超越了公开模型基线，且以人类原始参考为基准。展望未来，我们计划为所罗门皮金语和比斯拉马语开发人工翻译测试集，并将我们的最佳模型蒸馏为更小型的模型，同时保持广泛的领域覆盖能力。
